原主叫江晚，家在一个二线城市，十岁的时候父母出意外双亡，寄住在大伯家。

因为原主父母是出意外死的，赔了不少钱，那些钱本来够原主念完大学。但是大伯一家对她并不好，那些钱被大伯拿走了不说，在大伯家也被他们当成了佣人，连她考上高中的学费都不给出。

原主一边读书一边打工，半工半读想要念完高中，但是高三那年，她那个大伯却想将她嫁给一个四十多的老男人，原主不想自己一辈子就这么毁掉，从大伯家逃了出来。

又怕大伯一家找自己，原主心一横，从那个二线城市，到了一线城市青市。

到青市后，原主阴错阳差踏入了娱乐圈，一开始只是接一些龙套，后来因为她长得不错，运气好能接到比较有身份的丫鬟这类角色。

后来在一部戏中拿到了一个女三的角色，那个角色人物讨喜，加上又是青春剧，播出后，原主小火了一把，成功签约东方娱乐。

也是因此，原主迎来了她一生的悲剧——东方娱乐的总裁席墨。

这个位面的男主。

说起来原主完全是躺枪，她不过是用来给女主做挡箭牌的。

女主叫夏满，夏满和席墨打小就认识，高中毕业，夏满无故出国，席墨觉得夏满违背了他们之间的诺言，从一个暖男黑化成了一个喜怒无常，只手遮天的霸道总裁。

可就在这时，夏满回来了，并进了娱乐圈。

两人第一次见面的时候，原主正巧从两人身边过去，席墨顺手就抓了她，宣布她是他的女朋友，夏满直接被气走了，席墨也扔开原主独自离开。

第二天，席墨的助理就找上她，安排了最好的经纪人，配了最好的团队，势必要将她捧红的节奏。

席墨的要求，在他需要原主出场的时候，随叫随到。

席墨是大BOSS，原主一个一穷二白毫无后台的十八线小明星，加上原主常年寄住别人家，早就习惯看人脸色，养成了自卑懦弱的性子，哪里敢不从。

她小心翼翼的待在席墨身边，并不敢奢望喜欢席墨。

是的，在原主心底，席墨就是高不可攀的神祗，她的喜欢卑微到了尘埃，喜欢席墨都是一种奢望。

有席墨明面上‘护’着，她的星途在那段时间绝对是走得最顺的，但是紧随而至的还有刁难，排挤，嘲讽……

在席墨看不到的地方，她经受了无数的折磨。

席墨的最终目的是让原主吸引这本小说中头号恶毒女配的注意力，而原主也确实做到了。

席墨和夏满在她的掩护下，早就和好如初，所有人的视线都放在她身上，等众人回神，夏满已经红遍全国。

Chapter 21 The financial owner is hiding behind me (1) - "The villain BOSS is poisonous"

The original owner's name is Jiang Wan, who lives in a second-tier city. When he was ten years old, his parents died in an accident, and he stayed at his uncle's house.

Because the original owner's parents died in an accident, he lost a lot of money. The money was enough for the original owner to finish college.But the uncle's family didn't treat her well. Not only did the uncle take the money, but they also treated her as a servant in the uncle's house, and they didn't even pay her tuition for high school.

The original owner worked part-time while studying, and wanted to finish high school while working part-time. However, in her senior year of high school, her uncle wanted to marry her to an old man in his forties. The original owner did not want her life to be ruined like this, so she ran away from her uncle's house.

Also afraid that his uncle's family would find him, the original owner decided to move from that second-tier city to the first-tier city of Qingshi.

After arriving in Qingshi, the original owner entered the entertainment industry by accident. At first, she just took some bit parts. Later, because she was good-looking, she was lucky enough to get roles such as maids with higher status.

Later, I got the role of the third female lead in a drama. The character was lovable, and it was a youth drama. After it was aired, the original host became popular and successfully signed a contract with Oriental Entertainment.

Because of this, the original owner ushered in the tragedy of her life - Xi Mo, the president of Oriental Entertainment.

The male protagonist of this plane.

Speaking of which, the original owner was completely lying, and she was just used as a shield for the heroine.

The heroine's name is Xia Man. Xia Man and Xi Mo have known each other since they were children. After graduating from high school, Xia Man went abroad for no reason. Xi Mo felt that Xia Man violated their promise and changed from a warm-hearted man to a moody and overbearing CEO with one hand covering the sky.

But at this moment, Xia Man came back and entered the entertainment industry.

When the two met for the first time, the original owner happened to pass by them. Xi Mo grabbed her and announced that she was his girlfriend. Xia Man was immediately angry and left, and Xi Mo also left the original owner and left alone.

The next day, Xi Mo's assistant came to her and arranged for the best agent and the best team, which was bound to make her famous.

Xi Mo's request is that when he needs the original owner to appear, he will be there at his call.

Xi Mo is the big boss. The original owner is a poor 18th-tier starlet with no background. In addition, the original owner has been living in other people's homes all year round. He has long been accustomed to looking at people's faces and has developed a low self-esteem and cowardly character. There is no way he dares to disobey.

She stayed by Xi Mo's side cautiously and did not dare to expect to like Xi Mo.

Yes, in the heart of the original owner, Xi Mo is an unattainable god. Her love is as humble as dust, and liking Xi Mo is a luxury.

Youxi Moming's face was 'protecting', and her stardom was definitely the smoothest during that period, but it was followed by making things difficult, ostracizing, and ridiculing...

She endured countless tortures where Xi Mo couldn't see her.

Xi Mo's ultimate goal was to let the original owner attract the attention of the most vicious female supporting character in this novel, and the original owner did exactly that.

Under her protection, Xi Mo and Xia Man had reconciled long ago. Everyone's eyes were on her. By the time everyone came to their senses, Xia Man had become famous all over the country.
